title: Michael Kosta Faults Trump for Shrugging Off Mass Tech Failures
summary: “Maybe for Trump it’s fine,” Kosta said on “The Daily Show.” “He doesn’t fly commercial, he doesn’t know how to use email, his bank is a guy from Qatar. For the rest of us though, it’s not fine.”
